'''2011 Worlds Day 2 Caleb Foth LS Mind What You Have Learned''' was the Light Side constructed list played by [[Caleb Foth]] at [[2011 World Championship]] (Day 2).

Deck I got talked into this. L3 Strong Is Vader (V). L6 Maneuvering Flaps & Nick Of Time (V). Additional Great Warrior block not folded into main. See notes/batch8_notes.py.

== Deck info ==

* '''Starting Card:''' [[Mind What You Have Learned / Save You It Can|Mind What You Have Learned / Save You It Can (V)]]
* '''Format:''' [[Legacy Open]]
* '''Stage:''' Day 2
